method.rule: Adapt the upstream text; do not paraphrase it. What is taken here is the structure, and it is taken whole: a model of the reader that the rules are derived from, numbered rules each carrying a Bad and a Good, a named list of overrides, a persistence clause, and a mechanical pre-send check. The rules themselves are this project's own, because the reader is a maintainer deciding about their product rather than a developer being handed a task. Upstream sentences are kept verbatim where they say the thing better than a rewrite would.
method.reviewNote: The local rule held the same material in prose: rationale without examples, judgement without a checklist, and no statement that it still applies on the fortieth turn. Under the pressure of a fresh finding the judgement lost. This structure is the part that holds.

retained: a model of the reader stated first, from which the rules are derived
numbered rules, each with a Bad and a Good
lead with what the reader can act on, never with what you were doing
cap a list rather than letting it grow
matter-of-fact tone for failures: cause and fix, no alarm
no preamble, no recap, no closing pleasantries
a named list of overrides rather than an implied one
the override for a rule that fights the harness
the override for a rule that would delete the answer itself
persistence: the rules do not lapse when the topic changes, and if you are unsure whether they still apply, they do
a pre-send check that deletes named things and then verifies
modified: the reader is a maintainer deciding about their product, not a developer receiving a task, so the reader model states what they cannot see rather than what they cannot hold
time estimates are dropped: a gate has no human clock
restating state every turn is dropped as prose, because the checkpoint and wfctl brief already carry it durably and a second copy is a second thing to keep true

the ten rules are this project's own: the reader test, the substitution rule, one decision per packet, wfctl knowledge decided, re-establishing the subject, rendering rather than composing, never reporting by count, and keeping the blocker true

notInstalled.reason: This is a standing rule rather than something the maintainer switches on. It is loaded before project work, not invoked.
